name: 静音减震宽跑带智能跑步机款

category.leaf: 静音减震宽跑带智能跑步机

description: 静音降噪、宽跑带减震、立柱稳固的家用智能跑步机套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust screens, soft blue-grey #EEF1F6 for benefit, comparison and closing screens, graphite #25272C reserved for the pain strip and the specification block
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even daylight-balanced studio lighting, large soft front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows grounding the deck, no harsh speculars; 5500K window light in the home scene
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white studio floor #FFFFFF, matte blue-grey info panels #EEF1F6, textured dark rubber running belt, brushed metal frame tubes and graphite #25272C moulded parts
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines 28-48pt; graphite #25272C on light backgrounds, pure white #FFFFFF on the graphite and indigo panels; subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: rounded filled pill badges plus thin-line outline icon circles, single indigo accent #2B2FC4
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale across the set; all frame tubes, upright columns and deck edges perfectly straight; every screen surface kept neutral and unreadable
noDrift: no brand logos or model codes on the product
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright clean indoor-fitness visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white background #FFFFFF, soft blue-grey info ground #EEF1F6, graphite #25272C for text and the reserved dark info block, and one indigo accent #2B2FC4; bright neutral daylight tone; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent rounded filled pill badges and thin-line outline icon circles in the single indigo accent; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and consistent product scale; fully composed frames with balanced margins; all frame tubes, upright columns and deck edges perfectly straight; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表白底首图，轮廓干净、无文字无道具，靠点击率赢第一眼
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a slight 3/4 turn, full product visible, nothing cropped
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, large soft front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadow grounding the deck
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The complete treadmill shown at a slight 3/4 angle, straight-on eye-level view, whole product visible and nothing cropped. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a large soft front-left key and gentle fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the deck. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product fills 60-70% of the frame in the lower two-thirds, large and complete within the square canvas with balanced margins on every side, and the main image carries no text at all. Commercial e-commerce quality, 2K. Negative: no props, no people, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no model code, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges, no warped straight lines.

shots.intent: 一秒说清低噪畅跑这一核心利益，用胶囊标签列承接首图流量
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, product on the left third, badge column on the right
shots.lighting: even soft front-left key light, soft contact shadow, no harsh speculars
shots.background: soft blue-grey #EEF1F6 with indigo badge panels #2B2FC4
shots.props: three rounded filled pill badges and one thin-line icon circle
shots.textZone: 右侧 45% 信息条：一行短标题「{callout_1}」＋三枚靛蓝实底胶囊标签「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」白字
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The treadmill photographed at a slight 3/4 hero angle filling 50-60% of the frame on the left. On the right 45% a fully composed info column: one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #25272C sized 28-48pt beside one thin-line icon circle in #2B2FC4, and below it three rounded filled pill badges in #2B2FC4 stacked vertically, each carrying one short white label 「{selling_point_1}」 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」. Soft blue-grey background #EEF1F6, even soft front-left key light, soft contact shadow. Product silhouette and info column together balance the square canvas edge to edge. Negative: no more than one claim per badge, no dense body text, no invented performance numbers, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product, no extra text.

shots.intent: 放大户外天气与空气差、跑不成的日常摩擦，把需求逼到室内
shots.camera: flat frontal layout with no perspective distortion; the product inside the lower panel at a slight 3/4 angle
shots.lighting: dim overcast documentary tone on the three weather tiles, softer warm-free 5500K light on the bright indoor panel
shots.background: three weather vignette tiles on graphite #25272C above one bright indoor panel #EEF1F6
shots.props: three framed weather vignette tiles rendered as photo stills
shots.textZone: 三段式上部：每格下一行短说明「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」白字；下部室内面板一行短标题「{callout_4}」＋一枚靛蓝实底数据胶囊「{callout_5}」白字
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A straight-on flat layout with no perspective distortion: a top row of three rectangular photo tiles on graphite #25272C showing rainy, windy and hazy outdoor running conditions under a dim overcast documentary tone, each tile followed by one short white caption 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF, followed by one wide bright indoor panel #EEF1F6 in which the treadmill is photographed at a slight 3/4 angle filling 50-60% of the panel as the indoor alternative, with one short headline 「{callout_4}」 in #25272C and one solid indigo #2B2FC4 data chip with white text 「{callout_5}」 beside it. Negative: no fabricated statistics, no city or pollution data, no real people or faces, no identifiably branded outdoor street, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入居家晨跑的真实生活画面，让买家把自己放进画面里
shots.camera: eye-level 3/4 wide in-context view from across the room, candid feel, floor-level depth
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow under the deck, no harsh contrast
shots.background: bright home living room, light oak floor #D6C3A4, pale walls #EDEFF2, large window on the left
shots.props: a folded towel on the handrail and a water bottle on the floor, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: natural breathing room from the window light and the pale walls around the runner
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} in a bright home living room beside a large window on the left. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from across the room at an eye-level 3/4 in-context wide view with a candid feel. Soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow under the deck. Light oak floor #D6C3A4, pale walls #EDEFF2. Props: a folded towel on the handrail and a water bottle on the floor, not covering the product; one person in plain dark athletic wear seen only from behind at a distance, no visible face. The runner and the machine fill 40-50% of the frame, with the window light and the pale walls giving natural breathing room around the scene. Negative: no visible face, no distorted limbs or extra fingers, no cluttered room, no duplicated objects in the background, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no impossible shadows.

shots.intent: 用跑带肌理与减震层的微距证明静音舒适不是口号
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a very low raking angle along the belt, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right at a low angle revealing the belt texture and the layer seam, controlled highlight, no harsh speculars
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, a tight zoom along the running belt surface showing its embossed texture and the soft damping layer beneath it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low raking angle along the belt, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right at a low angle reveals the belt texture and the layer seam, controlled highlight, no harsh speculars. Neutral matte light blue-grey background #EEF1F6. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only a thin clean margin around the texture, because the belt grain is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no dust or debris, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no mismatched texture scale, no floating parts.

shots.intent: 特写彩屏控制台与扶手操作区，证明配置齐全、上手简单
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at the console, close-up detail shot, shallow depth of field with the control area sharp
shots.lighting: even soft studio light from the front-left with one controlled soft highlight along the screen glass, no harsh speculars
shots.background: clean white #FFFFFF with graphite #25272C moulded parts
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.textZone: 屏幕显示中性抽象界面，无可读文字
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail shot of {product}, tight zoom on the console and handrail control area. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at the console, shallow depth of field with the front control elements sharp. Even soft studio light from the front-left with one controlled soft highlight along the screen glass, no harsh speculars. Clean white background #FFFFFF, graphite #25272C moulded parts. The screen surface shows only a neutral abstract interface with no readable UI text. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only a thin clean margin around the console. Negative: no readable screen text, no fake app interface, no brand logo, no invented buttons, no extra text, no watermark, no blurry subject, no warped straight lines.

shots.intent: 用同机位双格对比立柱粗细，把稳不稳的疑问一次讲清
shots.camera: two matched side-by-side panels, camera fixed at a low deck-level 3/4 close view of the upright column, identical framing, crop and lighting in both panels
shots.lighting: identical soft side light in both panels, same direction and intensity, even fill, no contrast difference between panels
shots.props: one solid indigo check badge #2B2FC4 and one neutral outline circle
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison of {product}, two matched side-by-side panels with identical camera, framing, crop and lighting. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera fixed at a low deck-level 3/4 close view of the upright column, identical in both panels: the left panel shows the thick upright column of the product, the right panel shows a thin ordinary upright column for contrast. Soft blue-grey background #EEF1F6 on both panels with identical soft side light. One small solid check badge filled #2B2FC4 sits on the left panel only and one neutral outline circle on the right; one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #25272C at the top of each panel. The column detail fills 55-60% in each panel so both halves read as a matched pair. Negative: no fabricated test numbers, no load or damping ratings, no mismatched framing or lighting between panels, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.lighting: even flat lighting, no dramatic shadow, no reflections on the table fields

shots.props: four two-column spec rows on a graphite table

shots.textZone: 四行两列参数表：每行左侧短标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_4}」，右侧短示例值「{callout_5}」至「{callout_8}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic specification screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A straight-on flat layout with no perspective distortion: the treadmill shown small and centered at the top at a slight 3/4 angle, below it a two-column specification table of four rows on graphite #25272C, each row carrying one short label 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 in #FFFFFF on the graphite row header and one short example value 「{callout_5}」 「{callout_6}」 「{callout_7}」 「{callout_8}」 in #25272C on a clean white field #FFFFFF to its right. Even flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. The product and the table together fill 50-60% of the frame, centered with about 15% layout margins. Negative: no invented numbers or units beyond the template text fields, no certifications or test data, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

A slight 3/4 low-angle view looking slightly upward with the treadmill filling 60-70% of the frame on the left and one deep indigo panel #2B2FC4 on the right carrying one solid rounded action button with white text 「{callout_1}」 and one solid filled price chip with white text 「{callout_2}」, all on a soft blue-grey ground #EEF1F6. provenance.notes: 从 8 张家用智能跑步机详情长图切片提炼：保留亮白底＋雾蓝灰信息底＋靛蓝胶囊标签的视觉语法，以及「场景大图＋图标徽章条」与三格天气小图、参数表的分镜节奏；已剥离原品牌字与机身型号字（M002 等）、模特面孔与身份（只保留背影跑者角色）、原文案（传奇系列、高端畅跑享瘦、新机怒放等）、会员二维码水印与认证标；屏尺寸、跑带宽度、马力、立柱毫米数、空气质量统计等全部数值不采信，参数与价格槽位由模板文案字段填充且不承诺具体数字。
